description.value: An fMRI study investigating how expectancy to smoke and abstinence modulate neural responses to smoking and control videos in healthy regular cigarette smokers.

spans.text: We therefore used fMRI to investigate brain activity in cigarette smokers exposed to smoking and control videos.

value: we predicted that cue-associated anticipation and planning of imminent drug use would involve the prefrontal cortex, in particular the DLPFC
We designed the current study to test the hypothesis that expectation to smoke would modulate the neural response to drug cues, especially in the DLPFC.
